'''Onsen-​nyūyoku Shidōin''' (温泉入浴指導員) is a qualification awarded to individuals who complete a course conducted by the {{ill|Japan Health Development Foundation|de|Japanische Stiftung für Gesundheitsentwicklung|ja|一般財団法人日本健康開発財団|zh|日本健康开发财团}}. Holders instruct bathers in health-promotion programs utilizing {{ill|Onsen|en|Onsen|qid=Q655311|lt=hot spring}} use and oversee safety management of hot spring facilities.

== Roles of Onsen-​nyūyoku Shidōin ==
* Provide bathers with instruction on proper general usage of hot springs and guidance for a healthy lifestyle.  
* Manage facility safety and carry out emergency life-saving procedures in the event of accidents.  
* Conduct regular training for hot spring facility employees on safety management and first aid.

== Program Overview ==
Established in 2003 by the {{ill|Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare|ar|وزارة الصحة والعمل والرفاهية|de|Ministerium für Gesundheit, Arbeit und Soziales|es|Ministerio de Sanidad, Trabajo y Bienestar (Japón)|fa|وزارت بهداشت، کار و رفاه|fr|Ministère de la Santé, du Travail et des Affaires sociales|he|משרד הבריאות, העבודה והרווחה (יפן)|id|Kementerian Kesehatan, Tenaga Kerja, dan Sosial Jepang|ja|厚生労働省|ko|일본 후생노동성|nl|Ministerie van Gezondheid, Arbeid en Welzijn|ru|Министерство здравоохранения, труда и благосостояния Японии|th|กระทรวงสาธารณสุข แรงงาน และสวัสดิการ|tr|Sağlık, Çalışma ve Refah Bakanlığı|uk|Міністерство охорони здоров'я, праці й добробуту Японії|vi|Bộ Y tế, Lao động và Phúc lợi (Nhật Bản)|zh|厚生勞動省|qid=Q1191238|lt=Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare}}, this qualification requires attendance at a two-day training course organized by the Japan Health Development Foundation. There are no prerequisites for enrollment. The curriculum covers five subjects:
# {{ill|health science|de|Gesundheitswissenschaft|ja|健康学|zh|健康学|qid=Q140446097}} (foundations of health-promotion medicine)  
# {{ill|thermal physiology|de|Thermophysiologie|ja|温熱生理学|zh|热生理学|qid=DELETED_QID}} (hot spring environment and health)  
# {{ill|balneology|de|Balneologie|ja|温泉医学|zh|温泉医学|qid=Q789523}} (general and specialized topics in hot spring medicine, including {{ill|rehabilitation|de|Rehabilitation|ja|リハビリテーション|zh|康复|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/rehabilitation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q2795791}})  
# Bathing program instruction practicum  
# {{ill|First Aid Training|de|Lebensrettungskurs|ja|救命講習|zh|救生课程|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/lifesaving course|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11499234}} (with practical training in {{ill|First aid|en|First aid|qid=Q133981|lt=first aid}} and {{ill|Cardiopulmonary resuscitation|en|Cardiopulmonary resuscitation|qid=Q185325|lt=cardiopulmonary resuscitation}})

Placement of an Onsen-​nyūyoku Shidōin is mandatory in Ministry-certified {{ill|hot spring program–type health promotion facilities|de|Thermalquellenprogramm-Gesundheitsförderungseinrichtungen|ja|温泉利用プログラム型健康増進施設|zh|温泉利用项目型健康促进设施|qid=DELETED_QID}}.
